text:
Situation: Sufentanil citrate injection remains in shortage at Corvale East with 64 vials on hand (7.1 days at 9 vials per day). Corvale General holds 134 vials (16.1 days at 8.3 per day) and Corvale Lakeside holds 50 vials (21.4 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA’s shortage list shows sufentanil citrate injection as Current for both Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. and Hospira, Inc., a Pfizer Company, with initial posting on 2022-05-03. As of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on FDA’s list for 54 months. The same plant received a Warning Letter on 2010-04-12 and additional OAI classifications after inspections ending 2011-06-17 and 2011-08-04. Later inspections were classified VAI, most recently ending 2019-11-21, which was 894 days before the shortage posting.

Our position: Internal redistribution can extend Corvale East’s supply without new purchases. The shortage is ongoing per FDA records; no resolution date is published.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 17 vials of 50 mcg/mL, 1 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval plus a DEA Form 222 or CSOS order for this Schedule II product.
2. Reassess inventory at all three sites weekly — requires pharmacy director approval.
3. Monitor FDA shortage list for status changes — requires pharmacy buyer action.

Not recommended: Initiate alternative opioid protocols or place new wholesale orders until the transfer is completed and FDA status updates.
